thesis: Munish Pabrai argues that cloning successful business models from others, rather than creating original ones, provides a significant competitive edge because few people emulate the best practices. He illustrates this by explaining that major companies like Microsoft and Walmart built their success by copying competitors, and he cites Radha Kishan Damani's D-Mart as a monopoly that simply cloned the Walmart and Costco models without any original innovation.
